Name: Vibrant Harvest Green Tropical Kitchen by Dracofly1192
Author: glymr
Description:
A conversion of Dracofly1192's Vibrant Harvest Green kitchen, made with permission. It works perfectly in the Ginger Island farmhouse, but also looks great on a beach-themed or tropical farm. Can be used in the farmhouse, cabins, or Ginger Island farmhouse independently. Can also be mixed and matched with other kitchen mods!

Highly configurable: Every part of the kitchen can be turned on and off via GMCM or in the config file. Options available for farmhouse, cabins, and the Ginger Island farmhouse. 

For the custom fireplace, check out the sister mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29526]Vibrant Harvest Green and Sunrise Blue Tropical Furniture by Dracofly1192[/url]﻿. Use the Alternative textures paint bucket on any standard fireplace for the colorful version from the images. 

Many thanks to tricksyfox, who made the new fridge door opening icon to match the original mod mod. <3

If you like this mod, it would make us very happy if you would endorse it. <3  Thank you!
